diagnosis: Loss of the Ethernet uplink path between ASW-17 Gi1/0/24 and AGG-2 is the supported fault domain. The evidence does not yet distinguish a patch lead, local port, or remote port fault.
reasoning: The affected subscribers share ASW-17 and its sole uplink to AGG-2. The switch remains powered and reachable, and its subscriber-facing ports are up, so the outage is downstream of the ONU but not explained by loss of switch power. The ONU remains online and the PON has no LOS or LOF alarm, which weighs against an optical access failure. The down state on the only uplink matches the shared scope of the service loss; the evidence identifies the uplink path but does not isolate which end or component has failed.
case_input: Topology: OLT PON port 0/3/2 serves building ONU B-17, which connects to managed access switch ASW-17. Eighteen subscriber drop lines terminate on ASW-17; the switch has a single Ethernet uplink to aggregation switch AGG-2. Impact: all 18 subscribers behind ASW-17 lost service at 09:12. The ONU remains online, its optical level is stable, and the OLT reports no LOS or LOF alarm on the PON port. ASW-17 is powered and reachable through its management interface; all 18 subscriber-facing ports show link up. Its uplink port Gi1/0/24 shows link down, with a corresponding linkDown alarm. No alternate uplink is configured.
excluded_causes: An OLT-to-ONU optical outage is inconsistent with the ONU remaining online and the absence of PON LOS/LOF alarms. A complete ASW-17 power failure is inconsistent with its powered, reachable state. A fault on one subscriber drop cannot account for the simultaneous loss of all 18 subscribers. The available evidence does not identify a specific failed cable, switch port, or AGG-2 port, so none can be named as the confirmed component.
supporting_evidence: All 18 affected subscribers are served through ASW-17 and its single uplink. The ONU is online with stable optical level; the PON has no LOS/LOF alarm. ASW-17 is powered and reachable, and all subscriber-facing ports show link up. The sole uplink, Gi1/0/24, shows link down and has a linkDown alarm.
